text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-8402 triggered for service="inference-prod-west". Symptom: sudden spike in 5xx from canary group (blue) in west region. Pager: alice
Details: traffic split 30% blue / 70% green. Started ~2026-03-15T01:14:xxZ.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: started canary rollout v2.3.1 -> blue (canary) at 2026-03-15T01:12:03Z. Planned weight: 30%.

alice: acked. I'm on it — will gather quick triage. Any customer reports? :eyes:

ben: seeing backend 502/502 gateway errors from edge-12 -> spike p50 from 120ms -> 2.3s for canary. Error-rate ~28% in the canary bucket on request path /v1/generate.

chandra: running quick DNS/edge checks. `dig api.redwood.ai @edge-dns-west +short` shows CNAMEs with varying answers; looks like some upstream resolvers still returning old geo CNAMEs. TTLs vary (300, 900).

chandra: quick curl to a blue host: ```curl -v https://10.200.45.12/api/v1/health --resolve 'api.redwood.ai:443:10.200.45.12'``` -> `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` with backend upstream error in logs.

ops-bot: Canary health summary: blue (v2.3.1) — error_rate=25% (1m), latency p95=2.8s; green (v2.2.9) — healthy. Autoscaling groups reporting normal CPU. KV cache hit rate unchanged.

alice: immediate mitigation plan: flip runtime flag + reweight at LB if needed. I'm going to flip LaunchDarkly flag `enable_blue_v2` OFF for prod to stop new sessions to blue. Will also prepare rollback if flag flip doesn't help.

alice: `/flag set enable_blue_v2 false --reason "canary 5xx in west"`

launchdarkly-bot: Flag `enable_blue_v2` set to OFF for environment `production` by alice. Change propagated to control plane.

deploy-bot: automation: initiating rollback for blue group -> restore v2.2.9 on canary hosts. Rolling hosts: host-3 -> host-6 (progressing). Estimated finish ~01:45Z.

ben: opened ticket CT-1043 and linked to PD INC-8402. Noted 3 customer tenants reported transient 500/timeouts between 01:15-01:27 UTC. No writes failed (no DB errors in logs).

customer-ops: forwarded customer-reported request ids and timestamps to support. Customers: tenant-acme, tenant-gamma, tenant-zen. They're being proactively notified.

irene: creating incident doc https://redwood.inc/incident/INC-8402 and assigning postmortem owner. Will capture timeline + customer impact.

alice: handing lead to ben — I have an offline window in ~12 minutes. Ben, take it over and I'll drop out once rollback confirmed.

ben: taking lead. I'll watch the rollback and edge routing. Starting live tail on /v1/generate.

ops-bot: Edge control-plane note: some upstream resolvers cached previous weights due to TTLs; while backend rollback is in progress we applied an immediate LB-level kill-route to force 0% traffic to blue IPs for 10m to reduce blast radius.

chandra: evidence of resolver caching: traceroute + curl from a remote-ish AS hit blue IP and returned 502. Sample: ```curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/ --resolve 'api.redwood.ai:443:10.200.45.12'``` -> `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` (timestamped 01:20:12Z).

ben: manually blackholed blue IPs at edge (iptables DROP) for 600s to stop further customer impact while rollback completes. Monitor only.

ops-bot: Monitoring update: canary blue error rate dropped to 0.9% after kill-route, overall p95 latency returning to baseline within 3m.

alice: any remaining unhealthy checks? If not, good candidate to mark mitigated.

ben: one downstream proxy host still flapping health checks (host-5), ops will replace it. No new customer reports in last 10m. Rollback progress: 5/6 hosts reverted.

irene: customer impact summary for timeline: approx 12-minute window (01:15–01:27 UTC) with transient 5xx/timeouts affecting ~3 tenants; functional impact limited (timeouts, retries), no persisted errors noted, no security or data-exfil concerns. Will include in postmortem.

alice: handoff complete. I'm pulling out of channel. Great job — thanks :thumbsup:

ben: keeping watch. If stable for 30m with error-rate <0.5% we'll close. Creating follow-ups: reduce DNS TTL for canary rollouts to 60s, add resolver-aware rollout gating, improve LB kill-route automation.

ops-bot: Incident INC-8402 status: Mitigated. Actions assigned: postmortem owner=irene, followup=tickets FOL-332 (DNS TTL work), FOL-333 (rollout gating). ETA postmortem 72h.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 01:45:02Z. Canary traffic restored to baseline routing (blue removed).

support-bot: Notified support queues, updated active customer cases with mitigation summary.

ben: I'll close after 40m if no regressions. Leaving notes for oncall rotation. Thanks all.

alice: personal note: add resolver sampling to rollout dashboards and lower canary DNS TTLs.

(incident channel archived once postmortem doc is linked)
